title: Star Wars
premise: A galaxy of thousands of worlds, ruled by an Empire or torn by rebellion — depending on who you ask. The Force binds it all together.

lore.title: Coruscant
lore.text: An ecumenopolis, a single city stretching across an entire planet. Its spires hold the Senate, the Jedi Temple, and the Imperial palace beneath endless traffic lanes and neon haze.

lore.title: Tatooine
lore.text: A desert world under twin suns on the Outer Rim. Moisture farmers scratch out lives beside Jawa scavengers, while Mos Eisley's spaceport shelters smugglers, bounty hunters, and Hutt debts.

lore.title: Dagobah
lore.text: A mist-choked swamp world where Yoda hid in exile. Its ancient Force energies run strong, and the murky jungle keeps secrets of its own for anyone who dares to wander its roots.

lore.title: Hoth
lore.text: A frozen world of blizzards and glacier plains, home to the Rebel Alliance's hidden base. Imperial AT-AT walkers march across its ice while the Rebels dig in against the cold.

lore.title: Alderaan
lore.text: A serene Core world of rivers, music, and art, known for its peace and culture. The Death Star destroyed it in a single blast, and the atrocity hardened the Rebellion's resolve.

lore.title: The Galactic Empire
lore.text: The authoritarian state that rose from the ruins of the Republic after the Clone Wars. It commands the Imperial Navy, legions of stormtroopers, and the Death Star under Emperor Palpatine.

lore.title: Rebel Alliance
lore.text: A coalition of worlds, cells, and veterans opposing Imperial rule. It fights through guerrilla strikes, intelligence raids, and hidden bases, betting everything on a single weakness in the Empire's armor.

lore.title: The Jedi Order
lore.text: Ancient guardians of peace and masters of the Force, trained at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. Order 66 nearly wiped them out, and the survivors scattered into exile across the galaxy.

lore.title: The Sith
lore.text: Dark-side Force users who value passion, power, and ambition over the Jedi's restraint. They work in secret under the Rule of Two, one master and one apprentice, plotting to rule the galaxy.

lore.title: Bounty Hunters Guild
lore.text: A loose network of hunters, assassins, and mercenaries who trade in contracts and credits. Its members answer to no government and will take a bounty on anyone, from smugglers to Jedi.

lore.title: The Force
lore.text: An energy field created by all living things that binds the galaxy together. Its light side and dark side are two faces of the same power, and users channel it through discipline or through emotion.

lore.title: Lightsaber Forms
lore.text: Seven classical forms of lightsaber combat, from the gentle Shii-Cho to the aggressive Makashi and Juyo. Each suits a different philosophy, and most masters specialize in only a few.

lore.title: The Death Star
lore.text: The Empire's moon-sized superweapon, able to annihilate entire planets with one superlaser blast. Its weakness, a thermal exhaust port, became the target of a desperate Rebel strike.

lore.title: The Clone Wars
lore.text: A galaxy-wide war between the Republic and the Separatist Alliance, fought by clone troopers and droid armies. Its end brought Order 66 and the birth of the Empire.

lore.title: Luke Skywalker
lore.text: A farm boy from Tatooine who became a Jedi under Obi-Wan and Yoda. He helped destroy the first Death Star, then faced his father Darth Vader and the Emperor for the future of the galaxy.

lore.title: Darth Vader
lore.text: Once the Jedi Anakin Skywalker, now a masked Sith Lord clad in black armor. He serves as the Emperor's enforcer, hunting Rebels across the stars with a cold, crushing hand.

lore.title: Emperor Palpatine
lore.text: A senator from Naboo who engineered the Clone Wars and dismantled the Republic from within. A secret Sith Lord, he rules the Empire from the Imperial palace on Coruscant with patient cunning.

lore.title: Yoda
lore.text: A diminutive Jedi Master who trained generations of Jedi and lived in exile on Dagobah. Ancient and wise, he taught that fear leads to anger, anger to hate, and hate to suffering.

lore.title: Han Solo
lore.text: A smuggler and captain of the Millennium Falcon, running cargo through the Outer Rim with a debt to Jabba the Hutt. Gruff and self-interested, he eventually throws his lot in with the Rebellion.
